title: Rabbi Chana bar Livai

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sanhedrin 108b. Hyman reports the reading Rabbi Chanina in Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin.

notes.text: The saved William Davidson digital paragraph on Sanhedrin 108b names Rav Chana bar Bizna (רב חנא בר ביזנא). Hyman’s heading instead gives Chana bar Livai and reports Chanina in Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin. The relationship of the supplied entry to that cited passage remains unresolved.

Later on Sanhedrin 108b, Rav Chana bar Livai recounts Shem asking Eliezer about Abraham’s war with the kings. The preceding ark story begins with Rav Chana bar Bizna and has Eliezer questioning Shem. Seder HaDorot also reports the Chanina reading in Yuchasin. The exact editions cited by Hyman were not directly checked.
